name: Ritual Focus Staff
blurb: Equippable ritual focus with three attachment sockets. Socket milk offering (liquid material, spoils in 2 days), flower petals (organic, seasonal bloom from pack flowers), or incense resin (resinous, burns at 180-220C producing smoke and scent). Sockets accept stable IDs: milk_offering, flower_offering, incense_offering. Material response: wood shaft, metal ferrule. Source: traditional druidic and Vedic staff as focus, not invented; see Rig Veda hymns to Agni for ritual tools.
